design.name: 👁️ Show Actions 1
design.note: On the Top set only. Also controls the divider next to the menu button, it appears automatically when Actions 1 are shown. The same logical property carries a different Figma name on the Bottom set (👁️ Show Primary Actions), tracked as showPrimaryActions. Also controls the divider next to the menu button, it appears automatically when Actions 1 are shown.

properties.name: brandInstance
properties.description: Slot to pass in the DBControlPanelBrand component

design.name: 🔄 CP Brand
design.note: Only offered on the Top set in Figma; in code the brand slot exists for both positions.

properties.name: drawerHeaderText
properties.description: Text to pass in a headline for the drawer header.

properties.name: burgerMenuLabel
properties.description: Sets the accessible label for the burger menu button of the mobile control panel.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Change the position of the mobile content panel

properties.name: meta
properties.description:
Slot to pass in a meta navigation.
Desktop: Above the regular control-panel-desktop
Mobile: Inside the drawer

properties.name: actions1
properties.description:
Slot to pass one or more elements like DBButton (e.g. search) as actions-1.
Desktop: Shown next to the main-navigation
Mobile: Shown next to the control-panel-brand

properties.name: actions2
properties.description:
Slot to pass one or more elements like DBButton (e.g. profile, language, etc.) as actions-2.
Desktop: Shown separated by divider at the end of the control-panel-desktop
Mobile: Shown inside the drawer at the bottom.

properties.name: skipNavigation
properties.description: Slot to pass an anchor or link to skip the navigation and jump to main content.
